title: Orphera inventory
description: The hosts Orphera manages, and the groups they belong to. Read by InventoryYaml.scala from the location given by -I / ORPHERA_INVENTORY. Rules a schema cannot state (names are unique, group members exist) are in docs/SCHEMAS.md and checked by utils/validate-schemas.py.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the file was written for. Optional; for sources that are not a file (a database, a connector) so a reader can tell what shape it is getting.

nodes.description: Every host. A node name is what --nodes, the playbooks and the config files refer to.

name.description: A node or group name. Used in commands, file names and log names, so only plain characters are allowed.

address.description: A DNS name or an IP address.

vars.description: Free-form variables, always strings (quote numbers and booleans: "10.10.5.12"). A node's own vars are not merged with its groups' vars by the inventory itself. The names listed here are the ones Orphera's own playbooks read.

cluster_ip.description: The node's address on the cluster network.

ceph_role.description: The node's role in the Ceph cluster.

osd_disks.description: Comma-separated stable /dev/disk/by-id paths that cephadm_add_osds turns into OSDs.

zap_disks.description: Comma-separated stable /dev/disk/by-id paths that cephadm_teardown wipes: every spare disk, including ones osd_disks does not use.

never-reboot.description: true: Orphera never reboots or shuts down this node (orphera reboot and orphera shutdown skip it, a reboot task fails on it). For hypervisors.

members.description: Node names. Each must be a node of this inventory.

never-reboot.description: true: every member is protected from reboots and shutdown, as if each had never-reboot set.
